snippet.title: Alan Wake 2 – The Lake House Expansion Launch Trailer | Xbox October Partner Preview
snippet.description:
A catastrophic event has occurred in the Lake House, the Federal Bureau of Control’s research station on the shores of Cauldron Lake. The Dark Place collides with our reality. Play as FBC agent Kiran Estevez and navigate the nightmare. 

The Lake House, the second Alan Wake 2 expansion, is available October 22nd exclusive to the Deluxe Edition.

Alan Wake 2 is available on PC on the Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S.

Developed by Remedy Entertainment. Published by Epic Games.

Find out more at https://alanwake.com.

The Lake House expansion trailer debuted in the Xbox Partner Preview on 17th October 2024.
